test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Shrewed**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the correct spelling and meaning of the word.
 
 
• **Shrewd**: having or showing sharp powers of judgement; astute.

 
 
• ​**Example**:* Ranjith is such a **shrewd **__businessman, he can make money out of anything.*
 
 
 
 
 
• *​*All the other words are spelled correctly.

​Hence, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the other given words.

 
 
• **​Edible: **fit or suitable to be eaten.
 
• **Restore: **bring back or re-establish (a previous right, practice, or situation).
 
• **Prosper: **succeed in material terms; be financially successful.
